_comment: The user's rulings on where topics start, by lecture key. Hand judgements, the grouping counterpart of runs/divisions.json. Positions are subtopic ids in the named voted division, so a ruling only applies to grouping runs made on that division. 'topicStarts' is every subtopic the user ruled opens a new topic; 'sameTopic' every subtopic ruled to stay in the topic before it; 'either' one set aside and scored neither way. A lecture with no entry here is unruled. Rulings were made on artifact pages that showed the full transcript, each contested point, and the topic names and reasons grouping runs gave on each side.

l1.note: Ruled from the 20 g6 and g11 runs. 2, 9 and 14 were starts every run made, shown as agreed and not ruled one by one. 17 is the closing goodbye, ruled its own topic in conversation. The five contested points, 5, 7, 12, 13 and 15, were all ruled 'same topic', giving five topics: opening, 2-8, 9-13, 14-16, closing.

notes.5: TLRs are associated with Innate immune recognition.
notes.12: this is not a clear topic on its own - it mixes part of the last topic with an aside.
notes.13: This should be in the same topic. perhaps there is a topic title before subtopic 9 that neatly incorporates all subtopics before the next agreed upon boundary??

l3.note: Ruled from the 46 g6, g12 and g13 runs. 2, 5 and 12 were starts every run made, shown as agreed and not ruled one by one. Of the contested points, 8 (nomenclature), 9 (morbidity and mortality), 10 (incidence) and 15 (the closing) open topics, so 8 and 9 are topics of a single subtopic each; 7 (clinical risks of benign tumours) stays in the topic before.

l4.note: Ruled in three sittings. First subtopic 22, the closing passage on risks versus benefits, from the g6, g11 and g12 runs: its own topic. Then 4 (the carcinogen survey) and 16 (developmental stage), from the g6 and g12 runs: both stay in the topic before. Then 4 changed to a topic start, after seeing that Gemini 3.8 splits there in 6 of 10 g12 runs, following the lecturer's 'I'm going to think a little bit about those environmental mutagens now'. 2, 7, 9, 14 and 18 were starts most runs made, shown as agreed and not ruled one by one; 7, 9 and 14 are also what the five criteria in runs/criteria.json require.

l5.note: Ruled from the 20 g6 and g12 runs, then revised. 2, 5, 8 and 17 were starts every run made, shown as agreed and not ruled one by one. First ruling: 14 (the multi-step model) opens a topic, 4 and 15 stay in the topic before. Revised to 15 (hereditary predisposition) opening the topic, with 14 staying with genetic instability, after 7 of 18 Gemini 3.7 runs, 7 of 10 judge calls and all 10 Gemini 3.8 runs read 14 as closing the instability section ('So where does chromosomal instability map in this?').

l6.note: Ruled from the 20 g6 and g12 runs. 2, 5, 7, 14, 17 and 18 were starts every run made, shown as agreed and not ruled one by one. Of the contested points, 8 and 10 open topics; 9 and 11 stay in the topic before.
